text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Central Provident Fund (Voluntary Contributions and Annual Limits) Regulations 2021.

heading.en: Refusal to credit voluntary contributions to Fund

text.en:
5.—(1) The Central Provident Fund (Voluntary Contributions) Regulations 2011 (G.N. No. S 731/2011) are revoked.
(2) Despite paragraph (1), the Central Provident Fund (Voluntary Contributions) Regulations 2011 (G.N. No. S 731/2011) continue to apply to the amounts mentioned in section 62(2), (3) and (4) of the Central Provident Fund (Amendment) Act 2021 as if those Regulations had not been revoked.
